name: hub-interaction-frvcqp
goal: Answer confirmation survives refresh, project groups expose running first and due-state labels show the current work state.

evidence: Home answers lose their selected label on receipt or refresh. Live group summaries omit zero counts, and queued and inactive work appears on first expand. WIP and detail use a red past-due clock.

Needs-you scenarios assert dispatch only. Live overview scenarios check running rows without requiring the initial group filter. Past-due scenarios verify the unlisted queue but never inspect WIP badges. Strengthen all three existing paths.
